CORAM: HON'BLE MRS. JUSTICE M G UMA  ORAL ORDER Learned counsel for the petitioners is absent.
No representation.
Learned counsel for the petitioners has filed the memo dated 15.02.2023 seeking permission to retire from the case.
It is stated in the memo that he is not getting any instructions from the petitioners.
Learned High Court Government Pleader submits that the charge sheet is already filed in the year 2022, which was never NC: 2026:KHC:317 HC-KAR challenged by the petitioners.
Therefore, the petition is rendered infructuous.
In view of the above, memo filed by the learned counsel for the petitioners is accepted.
He is permitted to retire from the case.
Hence, the petition is dismissed as the same has rendered infructuous.
